ThingDef.label: replink
ThingDef.description:
A brain implant for working with the replimat.
A colonist with a replink, mechlink or biolink can contact the computer (right-click it) and become its operator.
The replicators of the computer's power network print by the operator's links: a link lets its group print, the link level sets the speed.
The replink prints items; mechanoids, mechanoid chips and subcores need the vanilla mechlink, bioreplication needs a biolink.
It gains experience from the value of items printed by its owner's computer: 6 levels, speed from 100% to 175%.
Self-installed, cannot be removed.

The biolink prints bioreplication: all genetics, archotech parts, resurrector and healer serums.
It gains experience from the value of bioreplication printed by its owner's computer: 6 levels, speed from 100% to 175%.
Self-installed, cannot be removed.
